run_partial_dependence: run partial dependence computation on a fitted sklearn estimator for specified features and return averaged predictions
create_partial_dependence_grid: create a grid of feature values using percentiles, custom values, and categorical feature handling for partial dependence plots
test_partial_dependence_brute: test the brute force partial dependence method that averages predictions over a grid of feature values across all samples
review_partial_dependence_recursion: review the recursion method for computing partial dependence efficiently on tree-based estimators like GradientBoosting and RandomForest
summarize_partial_dependence: summarize partial dependence results including averaged predictions, individual conditional expectations, and grid values for model interpretation
